content:
FINAL ENTERPRISE CERTIFICATION PROGRAM

Mission:
Do not add new features.
Freeze development except for verified bug fixes.
The objective is to certify IVX Holdings for enterprise production.

====================================================
PHASE 1 — SOURCE CODE CERTIFICATION
====================================================

Audit every repository.

Verify:

✓ No dead code
✓ No duplicate modules
✓ No duplicate APIs
✓ No duplicate routes
✓ No unused packages
✓ No circular imports
✓ No TODO/FIXME left
✓ No console.log in production
✓ No hardcoded credentials
✓ No test secrets
✓ No Rork SDK
✓ No unused environment variables
✓ No orphan database tables
✓ No orphan storage buckets
✓ No duplicate migrations

PASS ONLY WITH EVIDENCE.

====================================================
PHASE 2 — SECURITY CERTIFICATION
====================================================

Verify:

Owner authentication
Member authentication
Session expiration
JWT refresh
RBAC
Owner-only routes
Rate limiting
Input validation
SQL injection
XSS
CSRF
File upload validation
Storage permissions
API authorization
Secret loading
Password hashing
Recovery flow
Remember Me
Optional MFA
Audit logging

====================================================

====================================================

====================================================

====================================================

====================================================

GitHub HEAD

/health

====================================================
PHASE 12 — FINAL CERTIFICATION
====================================================

Return only:

PASS
FAIL

Every FAIL must include:

Exact file

Root cause

Risk level

Fix

Evidence

Do not certify until every critical issue is resolved.

Generate a final Enterprise Certification Report suitable for investors, auditors, and production operations.
